title: Market Weave: Competitive Intel Synthesis for Model Landscape & Enterprise Fit
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Produce an evidence-led synthesis that maps current open and commercial LLM offerings to enterprise fit patterns (security, latency, cost, quantization support, regional availability), surface substitution and procurement risk corridors, and generate a prioritized signals backlog for model onboarding and fallback policies. Deliverables: 1) concise 2-page executive brief (with top-3 substitution risk scenarios and mitigation), 2) a normalized model capability table for use by Sales/SEs, 3) a triage rubric and alert rules for the signal pipeline, and 4) a small prototype dashboard with regional availability / latency delta overlays. Scope: North America + EU primary; APAC sampling for edge/regulatory flags. Not in scope: deep per-model training provenance audits. Approach: combine empirical probes (quant/latency microbenchmarks from ENG lab), procurement interviews (Sales + 5 pilot customers), public signal harvesting (release notes, vendor SLAs), and automated monitoring of fallback events from runtime telemetry. Expected outcomes: faster vendor substitution decisions, clearer guidance for Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs, and concrete rollout triggers for Backup model policies.
acceptance_criteria: Executive brief <= 2 pages that lists top-3 substitution scenarios with estimated customer impact and recommended mitigations
Normalized CSV of ~25 candidate models with standardized metrics (latency@256, quant support, regions, licensing friction) ingested to shared Drive
Triage rubric documented in Confluence with at least 6 signal rules and example alert thresholds
Prototype dashboard wireframe and a working region-availability overlay populated with sampled telemetry for 3 regions
tasks: Run latency+cost microbenchmarks for shortlisted models (ENG to provide runbook)
Interview 5 sales/customer success reps about real procurement blockers
Harvest public release notes and license changes for last 6 months and tag risk events
Draft the executive brief and circulate to GTM and Security for review
Prototype dashboard skeleton and connect to sample telemetry (POC mode)
